diagnosis: The APM span search endpoint queries Elasticsearch for OpenTelemetry spans tagged with a specific session_id. It assumes the caller only queries their own session, but performs no authorization check against req.user.id or session ownership in the application database. An attacker can supply arbitrary session IDs to inspect user telemetry, navigation paths, and API parameters captured by OpenTelemetry instrumentation.
exploit_request:
GET /api/apm/spans/by-session/sess_target_admin_88123 HTTP/1.1
Host: telemetry.analytics.io
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1Ni...
